messages.author: f683b46c90893281
messages.subject: nice 3D displays for PCA analysis
parts:
Dear all, 

could anyone suggest some examples of R code displaying some very nice 3D plots (with colors, shapes, etc possibly in ggplot2) of the results coming from PCA analyses ? many thanks, 

 

-- bogdan

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: nice 3D displays for PCA analysis
parts:
Short answer is that ggplot2 doesn't do 3D perspective plots. You'll
have to look elsewhere (i.e. plots based on persp *or* the scatterplot3d
package *or* lattice::cloud *or* the rgl package -- these may give you
some useful keywords for searching ...

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: nice 3D displays for PCA analysis
parts:
Agree with Ben. 3D is out of scope for ggplot2. 

Can recommend rgl::plot3d(), but also plotly::plot_ly()

https://plot.ly/r/3d-scatter-plots/

Brandon
